services:
  train:
    image: {{image_tag}}
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: all
              capabilities: [gpu]
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./checkpoints:/checkpoints
      - ./src:/workspace
    working_dir: /workspace
    command: python train.py --data /data --out /checkpoints
